description_en: Asynchronously starts MCP Server connectivity and tool list detection. The first call prompts you to wait one minute for resource provisioning. Subsequent calls return a temporary Session ID for polling the result
description_zh: 异步启动 MCP Server 连通性和工具列表检测，首次调用会提示需要等待一分钟拉起资源，后再次调用将返回用于轮询结果的临时 Session ID
name: StartListMcpServerTools

parameters.help_en: The ID of the MCP Server for which to detect connectivity and query the tool list. Only the service creator can trigger the detection
parameters.help_zh: 要检测连通性并查询工具列表的 MCP Server ID。仅服务创建者可触发检测
parameters.name: mcp_server_uuid

parameters.help_en: The language used for the detection session
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the Data Management unit that runs the Data Agent resources
parameters.help_zh: 运行 Data Agent 资源的 DMS 单元标识
parameters.name: dms_unit
